# AppDimens .NET — LLMS.txt (LLM API digest)

> AppDimens for .NET 3.6.1 — responsive dp/sp for .NET MAUI, WPF, Windows Forms, WinUI 3 and any .NET host.
> Bit-for-bit port of appdimens-kmp. Author: Jean Bodenberg. License: Apache-2.0.
> Full guides + generated API references: ../docs/AppDimens.Net*/ (README.md + API.md per package).

## Mental model

- Numbers are sizes on a 300 dp-wide reference screen: `16.Sdp()` = 16 × axis / 300 (19.2 on 360 dp, 42.7 on 800 dp).
- Results are dp (device-independent: 1/160 in Android, 1/96 in DIP on Windows) unless the name ends in `Px`.
- Parameterless calls use the ambient context (`AppDimensAmbient`); every call also has an `IAppDimensContext` overload.

## Setup (one call per UI framework)

```csharp
// .NET MAUI — AppDimens.Net.Maui (in App.CreateWindow, BEFORE creating pages)
using AppDimens.Net.Maui.Platform;
var window = new Window();
AppDimensMaui.AttachWindow(window);                 // ambient + cache + resize watcher

// WPF — AppDimens.Net.Wpf (MainWindow ctor, before InitializeComponent)
AppDimens.Net.Wpf.AppDimensWpf.Initialize(this);    // XAML {ad:Sdp 16} is LIVE (binding)

// Windows Forms — AppDimens.Net.WinForms
AppDimens.Net.WinForms.AppDimensWinForms.Initialize(this);
AppDimens.Net.WinForms.AppDimensWinForms.Apply(this, () => button1.Width = DimenPx.ToPx(120.Sdp()));

// WinUI 3 — AppDimens.Net.WinUI (App.OnLaunched)
AppDimens.Net.WinUI.AppDimensWinUI.Initialize(m_window);   // XAML {ad:Sdp Value=16}, re-applied on resize

// Any other host — AppDimens.Net
using AppDimens.Net.Core;
var scope = AppDimensHost.Activate(new HostDimensScope());
scope.Update(widthDp: 1280, heightDp: 720, density: 1.5);   // from your resize handler
```

## Core API (AppDimens.Net, namespace AppDimens.Net.Code.Scaled)

- `float Sdp(this int v)` smallest width · `Hdp` height · `Wdp` width; suffix `a` aspect ratio, `i` ignore multi-window,
  `ia` both, `Px` pixels (`SdpPx`, `HdpaPx(ctx)`…). Doubles: `12.5.Sdp()`.
- Text: `Ssp`, `Sspa`, `Sspi`, `Sspia`, `Hsp`, `Hspa`, `Wsp`, `Wspa` (font-scale aware); `Sem`, `Hem`, `Wem` (ignore font scale).
- Inverters (need ctx): `SdpPh`, `SdpLw`, `SdpLh`, `SdpPw`, `HdpLw(a/i/ia)`, `WdpLh(a/i/ia)`; options `ar`, `imw`, `k`.
- Facilitators (need ctx): `SdpRotate(ctx, value, orientation)`, `SdpRotateRaw`, `SdpMode(ctx, value, UiModeType)`,
  `SdpModeRaw`, `SdpQualifier(ctx, DpQualifier, threshold, alternate)`, `SdpQualifierRaw`,
  `SdpScreen(ctx, uiMode, qualifier, threshold, orientation, value)`; `HdpRotate/HdpMode`, `WdpRotate/WdpMode`.
- Builder: `16.ScaledDp().Screen(DpQualifier.SmallWidth, 600, 24).Screen(UiModeType.Television, 40)
  .Screen(Orientation.Landscape, 20).AspectRatio().IgnoreMultiWindows().Sdp()` (also `Hdp()`, `Wdp()`, `Px()`,
  `Resolve(ctx)`, `CustomSensitivity(k)`; `ScaledSp()` for text). Returns dp.
- Full control: `SdpCustom(ctx, qualifier, inverter, ignoreMultiWindows, applyAspectRatio, k)`, `SdpCustomPx`,
  `v.ToDynamicScaledDp(ctx, qualifier, inverter, imw, ar, k)` / `ToDynamicScaledPx`.
- Contexts: `IAppDimensContext` (Configuration, Density, Xdpi, UiModeType, IsInMultiWindowMode,
  RegisterConfigurationListener), `HostDimensScope` (Update(w,h,density) → bool, FontScale), `AppDimensHost.Activate`,
  `AppDimensAmbient.Current/Require/Set`, `FakeAppDimensContext` (SetConfig, NotifyChange, UiModeType, IsInMultiWindowMode).
- Cache: `DimenCache.CacheEnabled`, `DiagnosticsEnabled`, `HitCount/MissCount`, `ClearAll()` (automatic on resize).
- Enums (AppDimens.Net.Common): DpQualifier {SmallWidth, Height, Width}; Inverter {Default, PhToLw, PwToLh, LhToPw,
  LwToPh, SwToLh, SwToLw, SwToPh, SwToPw}; Orientation {Portrait, Landscape, Default}; UiModeType {Undefined, Normal,
  Television, Car, Watch, Desk, Appliance, VrHeadset, FoldOpen, FoldClosed, FlipOpen, FlipClosed, FoldHalfOpened,
  FlipHalfOpened}; UnitType {Mm, Cm, Inch}.

## Strategy packages (uniform shape, namespace AppDimens.Net.Code.<Name>)

`{P}Sdp/Sdpa/Sdpi/Sdpia`, `{P}Hdp…`, `{P}Wdp…` (ambient or ctx), `{P}SdpPx(ctx)…`,
`{P}SdpCustom(qualifier, inverter, imw, ar, k)`, `{P}SdpRotateRaw(ctx, raw, orientation)`, static `Dimen<Name>.{P}Sdp(ctx, v)`,
`Dimen<Name>.WarmupCache(ctx)`, kernel `v.To<Name>Dp(ctx, qualifier, inverter, imw, ar, k)` / `To<Name>Px`.

| Package | Prefix | 16 @ 360×800 / 800×1280 |
|---|---|---|
| Auto | A | 19.2 / 30.2 |
| Density | D | follows dpi/160 (16 @160dpi, 32 @320dpi) |
| Diagonal | DG | 22.9 / 39.5 (rotation-stable) |
| Fill | FL | 24 / 42.7 |
| Fluid | F | 13.4 / 19.2 (clamped 0.8×–1.2×) |
| Interpolated | I | 17.6 / 29.3 |
| Logarithmic | LOG | 17.2 / 22.3 |
| Percent | P | 19.2 / 42.7 (+ literal %: `50.SpaceWDp(ctx)`, `SpaceHDp`, `SpaceSwDp`, `SpaceDp(ref)`) |
| Perimeter | PR | 22.3 / 40 |
| Power | PW | 18.3 / 33.4 (tunable k) |

- Fit (AppDimens.Net.Code.Fit): `16.FitScaledDp().Screen(UiModeType, v).Screen(DpQualifier, threshold, v)
  .Screen(Orientation, v).Ftsdp()` — returns PIXELS (dp × density); priority: UI-mode rules > qualifier rules >
  orientation rules, first declared match wins; `Fthdp`, `Ftwdp`, `ResolveAll(ctx)`.
- Resize (AppDimens.Net.Code.Resize): `DimenResize.AutoResizeTextPx(text, boxWidthPx, minSp, maxSp, stepSp, maxLines, ctx)`
  returns the chosen size in **sp** (unit of the range); `AutoResizeSquarePx(boxWpx, boxHpx, minDp, maxDp, stepDp, ctx)`
  returns **dp**; `InnerMaxDimensionsPx`, `ResizeRangePx(min,max,step).ResolveFitting(fits)` (≤4096 steps, binary search).
- Units (AppDimens.Net.Code.Units): `DimenPhysicalUnits.ToDpFromMm/Cm/Inch`, `ToPxFrom*`, `ToSpFrom*`, `RadiusFromDiameter(d, UnitType)`.
- Custom (AppDimens.Net.Custom, unreleased): simplest form: one line of typed C#, e.g. `CustomScaleStrategy.Create(s => s.Clamp(s.Width / 360f, 0.85f, 1.8f))` (factor) or `ScalingStrategy.Formula(s => s.Base * s.Pow(s.Sw / 360f, 0.8f))` (final value); as text for JSON: `ScalingStrategy.Formula("base * pow(sw / 360, 0.8)")`, `16.Cdp("…")`. Full form: `ScalingStrategy.Define(id, b => { b.SetReference(360, 640); b.Curve = ScalingCurve.Power(0.8f); b.Clamp(0.85f, 1.6f); b.On(DeviceClass.Tablet, r => …); })`,
  free-form `ScalingCurve.Expression("pow(ratio, 0.8) * (tablet ? 0.9 : 1)")` and `b.SetFormula("base * pow(sw / 360, 0.7) + 2")`, JSON `ScalingStrategies.LoadJson` (cross-platform format),
  `16.Cdp(brand)` (dp), `CdpPx`, `14.Csp(brand)` (sp units), `CspDp`, `CspPx`, `ScalingStrategies.Default`, `CustomDimens.Use(brand)`, presets `CustomPresets.*`. Guide: docs/AppDimens.Net.Custom/README.md.

## UI integrations

- MAUI (AppDimens.Net.Maui): `AppDimensMaui.AttachWindow/Detach/Init/Primary`, `WindowDimensScope` (Update,
  FontScaleOverride, RegisterConfigurationListener); XAML `xmlns:ad="clr-namespace:AppDimens.Net.Maui.Xaml;assembly=AppDimens.Net.Maui"`
  → `{ad:Sdp 16}`, `Sdpa`, `Hdp`, `Wdp`, `Ssp`, `Fsdp`, `Psdpx` (evaluated at load); `SdpConverter`, `SspConverter`.
- WPF (AppDimens.Net.Wpf): `AppDimensWpf.Initialize/EnsureInitialized/Detach/Scope/Changed`, `WpfWindowDimensScope`;
  41 markup extensions `{ad:Name 16}` (Scaled, Fluid F*, Percent P*, SpaceW/SpaceH) as live bindings
  (`DimenLiveSource`), options `Live`, `As` (Double/Thickness/CornerRadius/GridLength); `DimenConverter`; `DimenFunction`.
- WinForms (AppDimens.Net.WinForms): `AppDimensWinForms.Initialize/Apply(control, layout)/Detach/Scope/Changed`,
  `FormDimensScope`, `DimenPx.ToPx/ToPt/Padding/Size/Of(DimenFunction, v)`.
- WinUI 3 (AppDimens.Net.WinUI): `AppDimensWinUI.Initialize/Detach/Scope/Changed`, `WinUIWindowDimensScope`,
  `{ad:Name Value=16}` re-applied on resize (weak registry), `DimenConverter`, `DimenFunction`.

## Guarantees

- Fast lanes (`DimenCache.ResolveSdpDp/Hdp/Wdp(+Px)`) are allocation-free and bitwise-equal to the full cached path.
- Resize changes invalidate automatically via the event watcher — no manual cache clearing.
- Custom sensitivity-K values are never cached.
- Formulas are bit-for-bit ports of appdimens-kmp (golden values in DOCUMENTATION/PARITY.md).
